notes: Mode: census (date-seeded draw). Seed 2026-11-17-4dba. Subjects: ventures/ice-dam-removal-bid-calculator, ventures/rental-dscr-calculator, ventures/custom-farm-rate-calculator, ventures/docker-base-image-pin-check, research/simdesign-pocketmesh, ventures/uk-self-assessment-tax-calculator. Share meeting bar: 0 of 6 (census, not in the sampled share; sampled share unchanged at 33/306). All 6 finished. Seeded mutations caught 13 of 35. Each audit was written by one parallel subagent; I reran at least one headline recomputation per subject: rental DSCR payment 1790.71 and DSCR 1.26598 (independent python amortization); ice-dam emergency price 560 with cost 425.32 (node); custom-farm A3-24 19.64 ac/hr (probe and hand); pocketmesh beam floor w=15.0 (hand: 6*100*72.5/(2*225)+100/30=100); docker ARG FROM exit 0 (ran CLI); UK finance credit 86 / tax 1706.25 (hand from the GOV.UK rule). Fix PRs: #16786 (same PR): uk finance-cost credit limit excludes savings/dividends; custom-farm blank field errors; ice-dam privacy text discloses localStorage. Each new test fails on the old code (checked by restoring the old file). Local checks: node --test in all five touched ventures green (custom-farm 49, uk 33, ice-dam 115, docker and rental unchanged, 0 fail); quality_audit.py validate 392 files 0 problems.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
